DON’T REPLACE IT. RESTORE IT.

Your Boots Deserve to Last

We welcome loyal customers of the former Dave Page Cobbler’s shop! You can expect familiar staff, quality, and services here at Cobblers NW. We look forward to earning your continued business.

Built on Skill,
Trusted by Adventurers

We believe great footwear deserves a long life. At Cobblers NW, we bring decades of hands-on experience to every pair that comes through our door — from trail-worn boots to your favorite dress shoes.

Some things are worth fixing right. That’s why we take the time to understand your footwear, your lifestyle, and what it’ll take to get another few hundred miles out of your favorite pair.

I started cobblers Northwest to keep tradition and craftsmanship going into the future. We take pride in the fact that we have over 75 years of experience, with some of the previous great staff staying on so we can work together to create one stop quality craftsmanship experience while teaching for the future.
We are excited and look forward to working with our customers!

Tony Cunningham, Owner, Cobblers NW

BOOT REPAIR · SHOE RESTORATION · CUSTOM WORK

Expert Repair for Every Type of Footwear

Whether it’s your go-to hiking boots or a pair of leather dress shoes you’ve had for twenty years, we repair all types of footwear with the same care and craftsmanship. If it’s worth wearing, it’s worth fixing right.

Mens and Womens Dress Shoes

Heel replacement, sole repair, protective sole application, leather reconditioning, and professional polishing for designer and luxury dress shoes. We handle high-end brands with the care they deserve.

From stiletto heel tips to Allen Edmonds resoling to Gucci leather restoration — quality dress shoes are worth protecting. We have the tools and experience to service luxury footwear properly, so your investment stays looking and performing its best.

Hiking & Mountaineering Boots

Resoling, rand repair, rand replacement, and midsole restoration for trail and technical mountain boots. We work with Vibram and other premium sole materials.

Your boots take a beating so you don’t have to. We rebuild them from the ground up — so the next summit is still within reach.

Telemark Boots

Sole replacement, buckle repair, and structural restoration for telemark and backcountry ski boots. Keep your backcountry setup dialed.

Telemark boots are an investment. We treat them that way — with proper materials and repairs built to handle everything the PNW backcountry can throw at them.

Birkenstock Sandals

Cork restoration, footbed replacement, strap repair, and resole for Birkenstocks and similar comfort sandals. 

Birkenstocks get better with age — until they don’t. We restore the cork, replace the straps, and resole the footbed so you can keep wearing your most comfortable pair.

Sewing and Zipper Repair

Broken zippers, torn seams, detached soles, and stitching failures on boots, bags, and leather goods. We sew and repair what most shops turn away.

A blown seam or stuck zipper shouldn’t sideline your favorite gear. We use industrial equipment and heavy-duty thread to make repairs that hold — through seasons, not just weeks.

Brands
Our Expertise & Brand Specialization

We take pride in restoring high-quality footwear and leather goods to their original glory. Our craftsmen are highly experienced in the specific construction and material requirements of world-class brands, including:

Asolo · EMS · Garmont · Hanwag · Kayland · Kenetrek · La Sportiva · Lowa · Meindl · Merrell · Montrail · Raichle · REI · Salomon · Scarpa · Salewa · Tecnica · Vasque · Vibram · Zamberlan · Louis Vuitton · Gucci · Allen Edmonds · Churches · Christian Louboutin · Ferragamo

We also repair BOA lacing systems

We provide independent, expert repair services to extend the life of your favorite investment pieces. If your brand is not listed, please contact us to see if it is something we are able to help with.

Authorized Repair Partnerships

We are in the process of establishing authorized repair partnerships with as many brands as possible. Stay tuned and subscribe to our mailing list to be notified when we add any confirmed partnerships.
